summary: Sysco filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 12,345,679 common shares at $81.00 per share, closed September 16, 2026, raising about $967.4 million net after discounts and expenses. Underwriters led by Goldman Sachs, TD Securities, BofA, J.P. Morgan and Wells Fargo hold a 30-day option for up to 1,851,851 additional shares for overallotments. Proceeds will fund part of the cash consideration for Sysco's pending acquisition of JRD Unico, Inc. and Warehouse Realty, LLC. Deal terms of that acquisition were not stated; watch for further filings with target terms.
